services.description: List of services to start. Each item defines a service, its type (inet/cmd), command, and optional arguments (e.g., port override).

type.description: Service type: 'inet' runs as a daemon listening on a socket; 'cmd' spawns on demand

command.description: Absolute path to the binary executable for this service

args.description: List of command-line arguments for the binary (e.g., ['-p', '119'] to specify port)

enable_nntppost.description: Enable the nntppost service to allow authenticated NNTP article posting (required for user-submitted news)

sieve_enabled.description: Enable Sieve script support — necessary if NNTP users need server-side filtering (e.g., auto-forward or delete)

tls_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS-wrapped NNTP and IMAP services (requires valid certificates configured separately)
